newsitem.title: USA: Berkshire Realty to buy property manager.
newsitem.headline: Berkshire Realty to buy property manager.

text.p: Berkshire Realty Co Inc said its board has approved the acquisition of the residential property management operation of the Berkshire Companies LP (BCLP).
The deal will turn Berkshire Realty into a self-managed estate investment trust effective March 1, 1997, it said.
It said it will acquire BCLP, a property manager, in exchange for 1.7 million partnership units, or approximately $17.6 million of value in Berkshire's operating partnerships as of the pricing date.
The decision to acquire the property manager was based on the recommendation of a special committee of outside directors, Berkshire Realty said.
It said it expects the transaction to add about $0.05 per share to its funds from operations on an annualized basis.
BCLP currently manages Berkshire Realty's multifamily portfolio. BCLP is owned by certain directors and officers of the company.
In all, BCLP manages 57 apartment communities with about 22,000 units, including Berkshire's 35 multifamily assets.
